# AbPeak

> AbPeak is an iPhone app for ab training at home (six-pack coach). It estimates body fat from a photo (face removed on the iPhone, analysis in the EU, photos not stored), gives an Ab-Score for upper, lower and side abs, projects when a six-pack can become visible, and builds a 12-week six-pack workout plan (5 to 30 minutes, a mat is enough) plus a calorie target that never goes below the basal metabolic rate. No account needed. On the App Store since November 10, 2026: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826928194

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone only (no Android at launch). Languages: German, English.
- Price in Germany: AbPeak Pro 39.99 EUR per year with 7 days free, or 6.99 EUR per week. First scan included during setup. Other countries in local currency.
- Privacy: no name, email or password; scans and photos stay on the device; photo analysis via Google Gemini on Vertex AI, processed in the EU.
- Honest numbers: body fat shown as a range, projection as a time range, no guarantees in days or kilos. Not a medical device.
- Contact: support@abpeak.app
